item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-e2077c275931a6d7","start_unit":13,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"RSF reports that Chinese state media are state-owned or directly controlled by the authorities, the CCP Propaganda Department sends daily editorial and censorship instructions, and journalists reporting sensitive information face surveillance, harassment, detention, and sometimes torture; it also reports that journalists must use the Study Xi propaganda application to obtain or renew press cards.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The page is undated/current rather than specifically limited to 2023, but attributes the described media-control system to Xi's period in power.","ruler_attribution":"RSF explicitly identifies Xi Jinping as CCP leader since 2012 and describes the media-control system under his rule.","limitations":["The source does not provide a 2023-specific incident date or quantitative trend for each practice."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e2077c275931a6d7","start_unit":14,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"RSF reports that China uses broadly defined offenses including espionage, subversion, and picking quarrels and provoking trouble against independent journalists, and that residential surveillance at a designated location can place them in solitary confinement without legal representation and with possible torture.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The page is undated/current and does not isolate 2023, though it presents the practices as features of the current system under Xi.","ruler_attribution":"The source places these practices within the regime led by Xi Jinping.","limitations":["No specific 2023 case, order, or implementation record is supplied in the cited units."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e2077c275931a6d7","start_unit":14,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"RSF reports that more than 100 journalists were detained in China and characterizes China as the world's largest jailer of journalists.","question_ids":["3B.1","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The page displays a current detention figure and does not establish that the figure applied specifically during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The figure concerns China under the Xi-led government, but the source does not attribute each detention personally to Xi.","limitations":["The displayed figure is not a 2023-year-end or 2023-average statistic."]},{"source_id":"SRC-db955101883472ed","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"China's fixed-asset investment excluding rural households totaled 14,748.2 billion yuan from January through April 2023, up 4.7% year on year; private fixed-asset investment rose only 0.4%, while state-owned and state-holding investment rose 9.4%.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.8","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers January-April 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The data describe outcomes under the national policy and investment system led by Xi's government, without attributing the result to a personal decision by Xi.","limitations":["The statistic is descriptive and does not establish causation, policy intent, or distributional welfare effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-db955101883472ed","start_unit":2,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"From January through April 2023, investment increased 8.5% in infrastructure, 14.0% in railway transportation, 10.7% in water conservancy, 5.0% in education, and 12.2% in health and social services; regional investment fell 1.3% in the central region but rose 6.2% in the east, 3.2% in the west, and 9.8% in the northeast.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.8","6B.2","6B.3","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers January-April 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are national administrative outcomes under Xi's government; the source does not identify Xi as the direct decision-maker for individual investments.","limitations":["Investment growth is not evidence by itself of completed service quality, equitable incidence, or durable outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4608cb87f8631059","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"The Asian Development Bank raised its 2023 growth forecast for China from 4.9% to 5.2%, citing household consumption and public investment as drivers of stronger-than-expected third-quarter growth.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Published December 13, 2023 and explicitly concerns China's projected 2023 growth.","ruler_attribution":"The forecast concerns China's economy under Xi's government, but ADB does not attribute the growth specifically to Xi's personal actions.","limitations":["This is a forecast rather than a final outcome and does not establish distribution, sustainability, or causal attribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c3bf181ee1ddf1d1","start_unit":2,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"From January through November 2023, fixed-asset investment excluding rural households increased 2.9% year on year, while private investment declined 0.5%; state-holding investment increased 6.5%, manufacturing investment 6.3%, and infrastructure investment 5.8%.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.4","5B.6","5B.8","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers January-November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The figures describe national economic performance under Xi's government, without proving personal causation.","limitations":["The source is an official statistical release and does not independently evaluate data quality beyond describing revisions and coverage."]},{"source_id":"SRC-001fee1f7e767a98","start_unit":2,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"For full-year 2023, fixed-asset investment excluding rural households rose 3.0%, manufacturing investment rose 6.5%, and infrastructure investment rose 5.9%, while non-governmental investment fell 0.4%; health and social-service investment fell 3.8%, and public-facilities investment fell 0.8%.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.8","5B.10","6B.2","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly covers the full 2023 year.","ruler_attribution":"The official statistics describe outcomes under Xi's national government but do not isolate Xi's personal responsibility for each result.","limitations":["Investment figures do not directly measure service quality, welfare incidence, or long-term economic durability."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b483e88ec806823e","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"During talks with French President Emmanuel Macron on April 6, 2023, Xi stated that China supported resuming peace talks on Ukraine, creating conditions for a ceasefire, complying with international humanitarian law, protecting civilians, women, and children, and upholding the pledge that nuclear weapons must not be used and nuclear wars must not be fought; he also opposed attacks on civilian nuclear facilities.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.8","2B.1","2B.4","2B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated April 6, 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The statement is directly attributed to Xi Jinping in an official account of his bilateral talks.","limitations":["This source documents stated positions and proposed cooperation, not their subsequent implementation or effect."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b483e88ec806823e","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Xi proposed continued high-level China-France strategic, economic-financial, and people-to-people dialogue and cooperation on climate change, energy, green development, science and technology, and civil nuclear energy; the two presidents witnessed the signing of bilateral cooperation documents in these areas.","question_ids":["1B.7","5B.1","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated April 6, 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The proposals and witnessed agreements are directly attributed to Xi's conduct as China's president.","limitations":["The document does not provide budgets, milestones, enforcement records, or completed outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae39aa963da64001","start_unit":14,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that repression and social controls intensified in China during 2023, while the government appeared to moderate some aggressive rhetoric toward Western countries to attract foreign investment as economic growth slowed.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","5B.1","5B.4","8B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report explicitly assesses developments during 2023 and was published January 11, 2024.","ruler_attribution":"HRW frames the developments as occurring during Xi Jinping's rule and identifies the government as responsible, but does not assign each measure to Xi personally.","limitations":["The source is an advocacy organization's assessment and does not quantify the relative change in repression or rhetoric."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae39aa963da64001","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"HRW reported that Uyghurs and other Turkic Muslims in Xinjiang continued to face abusive policies amounting to crimes against humanity, with many serving long prison sentences for peaceful acts; it also reported continuing forced assimilation of Tibetans and severe information controls in Tibet.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.7","4B.3","4B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report presents these conditions as continuing during its review of 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The abuses are attributed to the Chinese government during Xi's rule, without evidence that Xi personally ordered each action.","limitations":["Information controls make independent verification of some Tibet-related claims difficult, as the source itself notes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae39aa963da64001","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"HRW reported that in Hong Kong the Chinese government arbitrarily arrested people for national-security offenses, offered bounties for 13 exiled democracy activists and former legislators, and expanded political intimidation against activists beyond China's borders during 2023.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.3","3B.5","4B.2","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report explicitly reviews these developments in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"HRW attributes the measures to the Chinese government under Xi's leadership; it does not document Xi's personal involvement in each measure.","limitations":["The source does not provide the legal texts, case files, or individual attribution for every arrest or bounty."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae39aa963da64001","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"HRW reported that vague amendments to China's Counter-Espionage Law and police raids on global and foreign-company offices created uncertainty over whether previously acceptable business practices had become criminal during 2023.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.9","5B.4","5B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report explicitly includes these developments in its 2023 assessment.","ruler_attribution":"The measures are attributed to the Chinese government during Xi's rule, not to a personally documented directive by Xi.","limitations":["The cited text does not identify the specific amendments or quantify the number of affected firms."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae39aa963da64001","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"HRW reported that, one year after the abrupt end of the Zero-Covid policy, China had conducted no official investigation into the government's handling of the outbreak, while citizens and journalists who reported on it or sought accountability for lockdown abuses were harassed, detained, or prosecuted.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report makes this finding in its review of 2023, referring to the policy's termination in late 2022 and the absence of investigation during the following year.","ruler_attribution":"HRW attributes the lack of investigation and subsequent repression to the Chinese government under Xi's rule.","limitations":["The source does not state whether any internal, non-public review occurred."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-079c75c8dcdfcfd1","SRC-2341cef6ce83eb62","SRC-e549fb03d00380b8","SRC-bad8b749f7a10ef6","SRC-b20cbf2ad7fcca2b"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents are undated, current, outside the 2023 period, or describe general institutional facts rather than Xi Jinping's actions during 2023; those documents were excluded unless they contained a concrete, period-relevant fact.","The supplied evidence does not support personal attribution of every national outcome or government action to Xi Jinping; attribution is therefore stated cautiously where the source concerns the government or system rather than a documented personal decision."]}
